learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn magical words that tell us more about our friends, toys, and the world!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Look at a red apple or the blue sky. Color words tell us how beautiful things look!
An elephant is big. A mouse is very small. Size words tell us how huge or tiny things are.
A ball is round. Your book is a rectangle. Shape words show us the shape of our toys.
Are you a happy child? Feeling words tell us how we feel inside. They are very special.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 🕵️‍♀️ Describe Your Toy!
fun_activity.instructions: Hold your favourite toy in your hand. Tell your mommy or daddy three describing words about it! Is it soft, big, or blue?

quick_recap: ⭐ Describing words are magic words that tell us more about naming words.
⭐ Words for colors, sizes, shapes, and feelings are all describing words!
